user.title: Select the distribution system operator
user.description: Select the DSO shown on your distribution bill.

tariff.title: Select a tariff group
tariff.description: Your tariff group is shown on the contract or bill. Local time is correct for modern AMI meters.

data_description.day_hours: Only relevant to ENEA G12; verify the hours on your contract or meter.

energy.title: Select the energy price source
energy.description: The regulated price applies to the default seller. If you switched seller or offer, enter the gross prices from your contract.

custom_prices.title: Enter gross energy prices
custom_prices.description: Enter active-energy prices including VAT and excise duty in PLN/kWh. Distribution is added separately.
